pick.name: Google Workspace Business Starter
pick.what: Hosted mailbox, Calendar, Meet and Drive on your domain
pick.why: Most trusted by enterprise buyers; full IMAP and admin
pick.free_limits: No free plan; Business Starter about USD 7/user/mo on annual commitment or USD 8.40 on flexible billing, 30 GB/user (USD figures from secondary sources; Google localises prices by country, check the pricing page for your currency)
pick.platforms: web + apps (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android)

best_free.name: Zoho Mail Forever Free
best_free.why: Only real free hosted mailbox (send+receive from you@domain with proper DKIM)
best_free.free_limits: Up to 5 users, 5 GB/user, 1 domain; NO IMAP/POP/ActiveSync (web + Zoho apps only); 'available only in select data centers'

alts.name: Migadu
alts.what: Flat-rate email hosting, unlimited domains and mailboxes
alts.free_limits: Per account: Micro $19/yr (20 sent/day), Mini $9/mo (100/day), Standard $29/mo (500/day)

alts.name: Fastmail
alts.free_limits: Paid only (30-day trial); custom domains on Standard and above; USD/EUR prices not re-verified (earlier fetch returned INR localised prices)
alts.platforms: web + apps (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android)

candidates.name: Cloudflare Email Routing
candidates.verdict: Alt: free forwarding, needs relay to send

candidates.name: Google Workspace
candidates.verdict: Alt: buy when an enterprise buyer expects it

candidates.name: Porkbun email forwarding
candidates.verdict: Free forwarding (20 forwards) if you register there

candidates.name: Zoho Mail Lite
candidates.verdict: Cheap paid upgrade with IMAP (price not shown in fetch)

decision: Google Workspace is the best overall because enterprise buyers and security questionnaires expect it. Zoho Mail Free is the only real $0 hosted mailbox (web and Zoho apps only, no IMAP). Migadu suits many domains cheaply; Cloudflare Email Routing covers receive-only aliases for free.
details: Set SPF, DKIM and DMARC whichever you choose.

verify.note: Checked against primary sources; wording made neutral during verification.
